item.title: Lindsay Clancy suffering 'command hallucination' when she killed children, court hears
item.description:
Another summer, another high-profile trial for everyone to lose their mind over. There was Boston’s Karen Read in 2024, Amber Heard and Johnny Depp’s battle over who abused who worse a few years before that, and now, there’s the case of Lindsay Clancy.
